1exjgoc.title: A tiny atomic shift gives scientists powerful control over metals
1exjgoc.media_credit: Photo: NASA Goddard Photo and Video / BY 2.0 via flickr

12jwbbj.ai_summary: Researchers have resolved a longstanding problem in Erwin Schrödinger's century‑old color theory, demonstrating that perceived color qualities arise from the intrinsic mathematics of color space. 18kszgj.ai_summary: Scientists are examining whether bees and ChatGPT possess consciousness, arguing that behavior alone cannot determine it and stressing the importance of internal brain or computational mechanisms.
